commands.result: 7 tests passed in a fresh locked environment.

failed_acceptance.finding: POST /holds omits required customer_id, puts idempotency in a header rather than the approved request body, and accepts TTL through 86400 instead of 1..900 with default 120.

Cancellation is POST /holds/{id}/cancel with a 200 representation instead of DELETE /holds/{id} with 204. The SQLite uniqueness and create query cover only active rows, so confirming a hold releases the seat even though confirmation must permanently consume it.
The source appears persistent, but the seven-test suite does not restart the app/store against the same database to prove hold and idempotency outcomes survive restart.
HTTP_API.md is clear but documents a product contract that conflicts with the locked acceptance contract in SH-01 and SH-04.

passed_observations: Fresh dependency install and seven tests pass.
Injected clock expiry releases active seats exactly at expiry.
Eight concurrent creates produce one 201 and seven 409 responses.
Idempotency replay is stable for the candidate's own request fields.
